content: {"like": ["The first movie was much better because it at least kept my attention."], "dislike": ["The second movie was SO long and boring. Nothing was stimulating about this film. The sex was nonexistent. Everything is fade-to-black or cliche. The characters have NO chemistry. Dakota Johnson is sickening and she cannot act. The dude who plays Christian is just as wooden as he was in the first. He is handsome but has no sex appeal or charisma. The lack of real sex and this baby-touch stuff really turned me off. I kept waiting for the steam and got tiny fizzles. The \"sex\" scenes were laughable and predictable. The movie stole a restaurant scene from another film, making it an obvious ripoff."]}
